workspace-stuckconnectionbanner--default.expression: () => { const status=document.querySelector('[role=status]'); const card=status?.firstElementChild; const host=document.querySelector('[data-stuck-banner-observed]'); return !!card && getComputedStyle(card).opacity==='1' && (!host || host.dataset.stuckBannerReady==='true'); }
